job.purpose: idle1012 head_h (ot_qwen_nearhbm_head_h, 128 inst) hierarchical rebuild via ref_tile: flat head = class 1 (one root over ~200k sinks) + class 3/5 (hid pin -> 1,024 q enables); sub-tile ot_qkh_lane8 x16 (8 lanes + K levels 1-3, own reset relay, pin flops in / registered out), 140.4 um ~50% util, M2-M5, PG M5; q6: HSUB bench uses the DPI _nr stand-in (b5d5477c7, peak 12 GiB vs 491), M5 layer cap

benches.name: layer_hs_mut
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && HSUB=1 HSMUT=1 bash tools/qwen_kv_die/bench_gate.sh neg {RUN}/bench/hs_neg 0

benches.name: anr7
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/anr7.vvp -s tb_hdc_add_lat_nr -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.LAT=7 -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.HMUT=0 rtl/test/tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/anr7.vvp

benches.name: anr7_mut
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/anr7_mut.vvp -s tb_hdc_add_lat_nr -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.LAT=7 -P tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.HMUT=1 rtl/test/tb_hdc_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/anr7_mut.vvp
